title: One Measles Case Can Infect 15 People
hook: One measles case can infect 15 people when protection slips.
closing: Small immunity gaps become community outbreaks, so every vaccination protects more than one child.
question: Did you get both measles shots?

segments.say: One measles case infects about 15 people, so even a small protection gap spreads quickly.
Measles needs 95 percent protection, and falling just short gives the virus room.
US measles cases grew about 9 times recently, showing how quickly a small gap snowballs.
